properties.ai_comment_en:
The region located at coordinates 36.29°N, 56.98°E offers potential for the "Lava tube and subsurface habitat" test at the Jezero Crater target, with a total score of 91.1. In this site, where the topography score is 98.8 and the geology score is 100.0, the parameters of mafic / basaltic surface (0.75), surface roughness (30.43 m on Earth, 29.6 m at the target), mean slope (1.19° on Earth, 1.11° at the target), and aridity (0.81 on Earth, 1.0 at the target) show similarity to the target. Additionally, the region has road access and is not located in a remote position.

In contrast, the climate score remaining at 57.7 and the diurnal temperature range being 22.74 °C on Earth while 54.8 °C at the target create a significant mismatch. Furthermore, gravity is at the level of ~38% of Earth's (~3.71 m/s²), there is no global magnetic field, surface radiation is much higher than on Earth, the atmosphere is very thin (~0.6%) and mostly CO₂, dust transport operates differently, and the annual average surface temperature ranges approximately between −40 and −75 °C relative to the target, being tens of degrees colder than desert analogues on Earth.
